failure: Serial sustained HTTP write returned 503 after 395 committed moves were reported at 220.1 seconds. PostgreSQL logged statement and lock timeouts obtaining the warehouse row lock.

host_observation.scope: Host observation after serial write failure; correlation alone does not establish root cause

diagnosis_limit: Severe host I/O and memory pressure was observed after the failure; this is correlation, not a proven root cause or evidence of production capacity.
response: Retain the failed gate and repeat the whole gate on identical software with fresh isolated resources. No write guard, journal, migration, statement timeout, retry or test duration was changed.
